# KinderLab Robotics

> Screen-free KIBO robots and STEM curriculum empowering PreK-5 learners with hands-on coding and computational thinking.

KinderLab Robotics develops KIBO, an innovative screen-free coding robot designed for early childhood and elementary education. Built on 20+ years of research from DevTech and Dr. Marina Bers, KIBO combines robotics with structured STEAM curriculum (Growing with KIBO and Exploring with KIBO) to teach computational thinking, engineering design, and problem-solving skills through tangible, hands-on learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- KIBO robot
- Screen-free coding
